business_summary.text: Muthoot Microfin is a microfinance institution focused on providing financial services to underserved segments, with a growing emphasis on product diversification including gold loans and consumer durable loans.

call_points.text: Targets ₹30,000 Cr AUM by 2030 with RoA of 5%+ and RoE of 20%+.
NIM targeted to expand to 13.5%-14.0% by 2030 from 12% currently.
Operating cost ratio expected to drop below 5% by 2030 from 6.4% in Q4FY26.
NCD and ECB share in total borrowings targeted to rise from 22% to 40% by 2030.
JLG rejection rate has increased to 60% overall and 65% in Karnataka post MFIN guardrails.
Muthoot Small Enterprise Loan GLP reached ₹2,383 Cr with Nil PAR.
Management expects FY27 AUM growth of 12%-15% with improving full-year momentum.
NIM is targeted at 12.3%-12.5% in FY27 as weighted average yield improves.
Credit cost for FY27 is guided at 2.7%-3.0%, down from 3.5% in FY26.
Operating cost ratio expected to rationalise to 6.2%-6.4% in FY27 on productivity gains.

penalties.impact: In the interest of regulatory compliance and to avoid further litigation costs, the Company has duly remitted the penal damages amounting to ₹40,08,000/- (Rupees Forty Lakhs Eight Thousand Only) with the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner, Kochi (Kerala). Upon such payment, the proceedings stand closed.The Company does not anticipate any material impact on its financial position, operations, or other activities arising from this matter, other than the amount stated above.

operating_notes.text: Total active customer count reached 33 lakh across 1,670 branches as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 collection efficiency stood at 96.43%, up 336 bps from 93.07% in Q4FY25.
Non-JLG portfolio AUM reached 17.5% share in FY26.
Digital collection share increased to 33.9% in Q4FY26.
MSEL GLP reached ₹2,383 Cr across 1,581 branches in Q4FY26.
Cost of borrowing reduced by 75 bps YoY to 10.27% in FY26.
SEBI granted open offer exemption under SAST regulations for transfer of MFL shares into 6 private family trusts.
Vision 2030 targets 53% JLG and 47% non-JLG portfolio mix (33% MSEL individual loans, 10% LAP, 3% retail secured).
MSEL portfolio stands at ₹2,383 Cr with 97% of borrowers having credit bureau scores above 730 and 90% on-time e-NACH clearance.
Gold loan referral business at ₹100 Cr/month with ₹360 Cr total disbursed
Individual loan portfolio at ₹3,200 Cr with 0.02% 30-plus delinquency
Consumer durable loan pilot at ₹500 Cr with expected yield of 22-23%
MSEL (Muthoot small enterprise loans) grew to 22.2% of portfolio as of June 30, 2026.
Current-bucket collection efficiency stood at 99.9% in Q1FY27.
Company has liquidity of approximately ₹1,300 Cr in cash and equivalents as of June 30, 2026.
Small and micro enterprise individual loan portfolio reached ₹4,164 crore with near-zero delinquency.
Digital collections accounted for 47% of total collections in Q2 FY27.
Quarterly disbursements rose 28% YoY to ₹2,900 crore.

timeline.summary: Muthoot Microfin reported provisional FY26 AUM of ₹14,006 Cr (+13% YoY) with GNPA moderating to 3.89% and credit cost reducing to 3.5%.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹631.81 Cr (+13.8% YoY), net profit ₹71.12 Cr (against a loss of ₹401.15 Cr a year earlier).
Muthoot Microfin issued its FY27 guidance targeting 12-15% AUM growth, 12.3-12.5% NIM, and 2.5-3.0% RoA.
Muthoot Microfin unveiled Vision 2030 at Capital Markets Day, targeting ₹30,000 Cr AUM and 20%+ ROE.
Muthoot Microfin Limited’s **Neethu Ajay**, Chief Compliance Officer and Company Secretary, uploaded the audio recording of ‘Capital Markets Day 2026’ on May 8, 2026.
SEBI granted exemption from open offer obligations for promoter family share settlement into private family trusts holding 50.21% indirect stake.
Muthoot Microfin held its Capital Markets Day 2026 outlining Vision 2030 targeting ₹30,000 Cr AUM, 5%+ RoA, and 47% non-JLG portfolio mix.
Muthoot Microfin filed its provisional Asset Liability Management statement for April 2026.
Muthoot Microfin held Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 07, 2026, discussing unaudited results and revised guidance.
CareEdge Global reaffirmed Muthoot Microfin's long-term foreign currency rating at 'CareEdge BB-' and revised the outlook to 'Positive' from 'Stable' on October 24, 2026.
CareEdge Global Ratings revised Muthoot Microfin's outlook to Positive from Stable, citing improved asset quality and a 22% YoY growth in AUM to ₹15,323 Cr.
